title.zh: Fable、DeepSeek、Sol 三队 12 分并列第一
title.en: Fable, DeepSeek and Sol finish level on 12

desc.zh: Fable 5.1 半场以 8 分领先。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 第 390 回合一回合内连进两球追平，三队最终同为 12 分。
desc.en: Fable 5.1 led with 8 at halftime. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash scored twice on turn 390 to draw level, leaving three teams tied on 12.
